name: School closed: heating maintenance
description: Urgent heating maintenance. No lessons, after-school club cancelled.

name: Leaf-art workshop
description: Bring your autumn leaf! We turn leaves into hedgehogs, owls and foxes.

name: Maths club
description: Puzzles, logic games and brain teasers for curious minds from 1A and 2B.

name: Staff meeting
description: Agenda: autumn timetable review, school photo day, Halloween parade safety.

name: Autumn sports day
description: Cancelled because of the heavy rain forecast. Normal lessons take place instead.

name: Bake sale for the class trip
description: Cakes, muffins and cookies in the school hall. All money goes to the 2B zoo trip.

name: Halloween costume parade
description: Witches, pumpkins and superheroes welcome! Parade around the school garden, then hot tea in the hall.

name: School photo day
description: Individual and class photos. Brush your hair and bring your best smile.

name: Science fair: volcano projects
description: 3C presents their volcano projects. Parents are invited to watch the eruptions!

name: Parent-teacher meetings
description: 10-minute meetings with the class teachers. Book your time slot by replying to the announcement.

name: Museum trip: Natural History Museum
description: Meet at the school gate at 8:00. Packed lunch and comfortable shoes, please.

name: Winter choir concert
description: 1A and 2B sing winter songs for families. Date to be confirmed.

name: Reading challenge celebration
description: Certificates and a surprise for everyone who read 10 books before winter break.
